rationale: param_efficient-claude-agentic: reg_type=foe, bilateral_on_top=True, proj_filter_on=True, n_iter=5, learnable_alpha=True, alpha_init=0.1, foe_n_filters=24, foe_kernel=7, foe_n_bumps=31, n_bf=3, bf_multiscale=True, bf_sigmas=[0.8, 1.6, 3.2], bf_kernel=7, bf_sigma_r=0.02, bf_gain_init=0.0, epochs=16, cosine_lr=True, lr=0.005, max_train_s=1080, batch_size=4, train_n=200, val_n=200, display_min=0.0, display_max=0.05, seed=42, rationale=iter-8 param_efficient breast -- PROJECTION-DOMAIN FILTER ON (sparse-view-native lever). SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: 7 iters prove the config-only GD-unroll caps at image-domain ~0.26. iter-7 per_step_alpha gave IDENTICAL 0.1897 to iter-2 -- the 5 per-step alphas COLLAPSED to one shared value; the loss landscape has no incentive to differentiate them, so config-only per-step-alpha CANNOT express a genuine VN. Combined with iter-6 (deeper DC WORSE = streak re-injection), verdict: the image-domain DC gradient R^T(Rx-g) is corrupting on 128-view sparse and no image-side knob escapes ~0.26. (2) FAILURE MODE: image-domain-only ceiling; the DC gradient re-injects streaks; no config knob learns to combine it. (3) ONE KNOB: proj_filter_on False->True (Manduca sinogram bilateral, +5 params: 3 sigma + log_N0 + 1 zero-init gain). It denoises the LOG-SINOGRAM on the Anscombe sqrt-count (noise-adaptive) BEFORE the FBP init, then recomputes x0 from the FILTERED sino, so it removes streak-CAUSING projection inconsistencies at the SOURCE rather than fighting them in image space. On dense Mayo this was null (FBP already averages proj noise); on 128-view SPARSE it is the native lever. All else byte-for-byte iter-2 (FoE+bilateral K5). (4) HYPOTHESIS: cleaning the sinogram before back-projection reduces the coherent streaks the FBP init injects, so the FoE+DC unroll starts from a cleaner image and hr exceeds 0.264, because sparse-view streaks are a PROJECTION-domain defect and this is the one lever VN/LPD lack. Zero-init gain => at init pipeline==iter-2 byte-for-byte (worst case == 0.190, no regression). (5) BUDGET: +1 sinogram bilateral per forward (cheap vs the K=5 image unroll); train_n=200, 1080s backstop + 200-val -> <20min. (6) SERIAL; iter-9 self-dispatches (next: if proj-filter helps, TUNE its sigma_r/gain or make it multi-scale; if not, directional streak reg +3p)., proj_n_bf=1, proj_multiscale=False, proj_kernel=5, proj_sigma_x=0.83, proj_sigma_y=0.83, proj_sigma_r=1.5, proj_gain_init=0.0, proj_N0=100000.0, per_step_alpha=False
